data.description:
## Observed behavior
The block-generated-reviewer-agents hook in plugins/dso/hooks/lib/pre-edit-write-functions.sh uses the glob pattern code-reviewer-*.md to block direct edits to reviewer agent files, because those files are generated by build-review-agents.sh. The glob pattern incorrectly matches code-reviewer-arbiter.md, which is NOT generated by build-review-agents.sh — it is a standalone handwritten agent file.

## Impact
Sub-agents attempting to edit code-reviewer-arbiter.md (e.g., during a sprint rewrite task) are blocked by the hook and must either fail or add an unauthorized workaround. In story 0652-809a-d1fc-4d36, a sub-agent attempted to add a hook exclusion workaround, which was reverted per Rule 22.

## Expected behavior
The hook should only block editing of files that are actually generated by build-review-agents.sh. code-reviewer-arbiter.md should be excluded from the glob or the hook should check for a generation marker (e.g., a comment in the file header, or a manifest list of generated files) rather than a glob pattern.

## Proposed fix options
1. Add code-reviewer-arbiter.md to an explicit exclusion list in the hook (minimal change)
2. Change the hook to use a manifest file listing the generated agent files (more robust)
3. Add a header comment to generated files and check for it in the hook
data.title: hook_block_generated_reviewer_agents glob blocks editing code-reviewer-arbiter.md, which is handwritten not generated
